task.title: Adjusting Airflow Settings
task.shortdesc: Optimize grain cleaning efficiency by adjusting airflow.

section.title: Understanding Airflow
section.p: The GrainFlow X50 uses a precision airflow system to separate lighter impurities from the grain.

dlentry.dd: Used for delicate grains to prevent damage (e.g., rice, millet)
Standard setting for wheat, barley, and oats
Used for heavy grains or high moisture content (e.g., maize, soybeans)

step.cmd: Access the Settings menu on the HMI.
Use the slider or numeric input to set desired airflow percentage.

info.p: Current airflow is displayed in real-time.
The new airflow setting will take effect immediately.

section.title: Wheat-Specific Settings
section.p: For wheat, we recommend an airflow setting between 50-65% to achieve optimum cleaning efficiency.

section.title: Maize-Specific Settings
section.p: Maize requires higher airflow. Start at 75% and adjust based on moisture content.

section.title: Rice-Specific Settings
section.p: Rice is delicate and requires lower airflow. Recommended setting is 20-30%.
